title: ZEUS Employee Handbook
content:
ZEUS Employee Handbook · Page 1
Section 1 covers working hours, annual leave and sick leave.
The standard work week is 40 hours. The standard day runs from
09:00 to 17:30 local time with a 60-minute unpaid lunch break.
Employees work on site three days per week: Tuesday, Wednesday
and Thursday. Friday is the company-wide remote day.
Annual leave accrues at 22 days per calendar year, credited to
employees in equal monthly instalments on the last working day
of each month. At most 5 unused annual leave days may be carried
into the next calendar year; any amount above 5 days is
forfeited on 31 December of the accrual year.
Sick leave is granted at 10 days per calendar year and is unpaid.
Absences longer than 3 consecutive working days require a
medical certificate submitted to People Operations.
Section owner: Priya Raghunathan, Head of People Operations.

ZEUS Employee Handbook · Page 2
Section 2 covers the annual compensation review and the conduct
escalation ladder.
The 2025 annual compensation review cycle runs from 2025-02-03
to 2025-02-28 inclusive. Managers must submit recommendations by
2025-02-21; late submissions are deferred to the 2026 cycle.
Cycle owner: Marcus Delacroix, Director of Total Rewards.
A performance or conduct concern is escalated in exactly three
steps, and no step may be skipped:
  Step 1: an informal conversation between the employee and the
          direct manager, recorded in the manager's notes.
  Step 2: a written warning issued by the assigned HR Business
          Partner and acknowledged by the employee in writing.
  Step 3: suspension of the employee and referral of the case to
          the Employee Relations Committee, which decides within
          15 business days.
An employee may file a grievance at any time within 45 calendar
days after the date of the incident that gave rise to it. A
grievance filed later is rejected without review.
